# Arm structural joints: C1 tie-rod joints + M1 inline roll (generated by `python -m rnd.joints`)

C1: the pitch hub → pitch tube and the yaw flange → yaw tube joints were 6 × M3 into heat-set inserts in pull-out. Both
are now **tie-rod joints**: steel or aluminium threads only, the printed tube and hub clamped in compression between
metal parts (rnd/parts/shoulder.py HUB_TIE, rnd/parts/roll.py YAW_TIE). M1: the inline GIM8108-36 output boss, its rear
screws and its hard stops.

Loads at each joint interface come from the twin (rnd/twin.py, CAD masses) as the full wrench of everything outboard of
the interface: **pull-off** N (along the joint axis, outboard), **bending** M (the prying moment, perpendicular to the
axis), **torsion** T (about the axis, carried by the double-D / hex form fit, not by the tie).
- **Basket** (R2d): the rnd/basket.py targets with the D20 motors and 4.54 kg per hand; every collision-free IK solution
  is kept (an upper bound on the planner's pick), × 1.5 dynamic.
- **Hug** (R2c, rnd/payload_study.py case B): upper arm hanging, forearm horizontal, 4.54 kg 0.30 m out along the
  forearm, yaw 0/±45°, × 1.5 dynamic.
- **Bump**: 140 N at the grasp point (R17 transient contact limit) in ±X/±Y/±Z, arm hanging / forward / abducted /
  elbow 90°, plus the arm's weight. A fault/abuse load: checked against ultimate, the joint may gap.
- **Stall**: each of pitch, roll and elbow at its peak (D20 set, the worse one) driving the hand into a rigid block (the
  block force = stall torque / lever, in the joint's direction of motion), same poses. Fault load, as the bump.

Joint model (clamp()): a rigid metal end plate (crank/clamp ring, aluminium flange) on the printed contact annulus,
which is a compression-only elastic foundation (E 1.8 GPa over the printed stack length), with the bolts/tie as springs
holding the preload. It gives the moment at which the interface starts to gap, and the bolt force and peak printed
contact stress under each case. Criteria: service (basket, hug) no gap and contact ≤ 12 MPa; fault (bump, stall) bolt
≤ proof load, thread strip ≥ 1.5 × the bolt force, contact ≤ 40 MPa (PETG compressive yield ≈ 55–60 MPa, ESTIMATE;
compression closes the layers, so the across-layer 12 MPa does not apply). Preload loss by creep × 0.75 (as the other
printed joints, ESTIMATE until the coupon).

## Hardware

- **Pitch hub ↔ pitch tube** (rnd/parts/shoulder.py HUB_TIE): 4 × M4 class 10.9 studs (DIN 976-1, cut to 78.8 mm) on r 15.5 at 45° + k·90°, Loctite 270 into the 7075-T6 balancer crank (tapped through 4 mm, stud end flush with its inboard face), Ø4.5 holes through the tube wall (now r 11–20) and the hub, M4 nuts (ISO 4032 class 8, Loctite 243) on a 6061 clamp ring r 11–21 × 2 in a 5.7 mm recess of the detach face; 1.5 kN each (≈ 1.3 N·m, ESTIMATE). Assembly: tube into the inner wall → crank + studs from the inboard side → belt → outer wall → hub over the double-D and the studs → ring, nuts.
- **Yaw flange ↔ yaw tube** (rnd/parts/roll.py YAW_TIE): the flange is now 6061-T6 (machined, ESTIMATE $25; its hex spigot stays the torque path). 6 × M3 × 40 ISO 4762 class 12.9 go down from the tube's top end, heads on a steel clamp ring r 8.5–16.8 × 2 in a Ø34 × 5.5 counterbore (heads 0.5 mm under the top, 0.5 mm under the top plate, under the yaw AS5048A board), through Ø3.4 holes in the wall (bore Ø16 for the ribbon) into M3 threads tapped at the hex corners (r 11) of the flange's spigot + plate (8.3 mm engaged, tips 3.3 mm inside its underside, Loctite 243); 1.0 kN each (≈ 0.5 N·m). Tightened from above on the bench, before the yaw block goes onto the roll output.
- Not drawn (rnd/parts/arm.py, arm track): the upper bone ↔ yaw flange screws. With the flange in aluminium they should be M4 into tapped holes in the flange, heads on washers on the bone flange, not inserts.

## C1: capacity per load case

Before = the wave-2 joint (6 × M3 into heat-set inserts, ≈ 1.0 kN pull-out ESTIMATE, force per insert = M/(3r) + N/6, as the review). Service rows (basket, hug) need no gap and ≤ 12 MPa; fault rows (bump, stall) need bolt ≤ proof, thread strip ≥ 1.5 × bolt, contact ≤ 40 MPa.

| Joint | Case | Pull-off (N) | Bending (N·m) | Worst pose | Before: inserts | After | Margin | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pitch hub ↔ tube | basket × 1.5 | 0 | 16.8 | floor pick, x 0.50 | 2.77× | no gap up to 84 N·m; bolt 1.58 kN; contact 7.9 MPa (≤ 12) | 1.52× | ✅ |
| pitch hub ↔ tube | hug × 1.5 | 0 | 29.9 | yaw -45°, elbow -90° | 1.56× | no gap up to 84 N·m; bolt 1.93 kN; contact 8.9 MPa (≤ 12) | 1.34× | ✅ |
| pitch hub ↔ tube | bump 140 N | 140 | 130.4 | abducted 90°, -Z | 0.35× | gaps; bolt 4.66 kN vs proof 7.29 kN; thread strip in the 7075-T6 crank (4 mm tapped) 11.6 kN (2.5× the bolt, need 1.5×); contact 17.0 MPa (≤ 40) | 1.56× | ✅ |
| pitch hub ↔ tube | stall (pitch 63 / roll 103 / elbow 63 N·m) | 343 | 184.0 | roll stall, elbow 90° | 0.25× | gaps; bolt 6.14 kN vs proof 7.29 kN; thread strip in the 7075-T6 crank (4 mm tapped) 11.6 kN (1.9× the bolt, need 1.5×); contact 21.6 MPa (≤ 40) | 1.19× | ✅ |
| yaw flange ↔ tube | basket × 1.5 | 101 | 32.6 | floor pick, x 0.50 | 1.48× | no gap up to 71 N·m; bolt 1.45 kN; contact 10.3 MPa (≤ 12) | 1.16× | ✅ |
| yaw flange ↔ tube | hug × 1.5 | 102 | 24.1 | yaw -45°, elbow -90° | 1.99× | no gap up to 71 N·m; bolt 1.27 kN; contact 9.5 MPa (≤ 12) | 1.27× | ✅ |
| yaw flange ↔ tube | bump 140 N | 163 | 96.1 | abducted 90°, -Z | 0.51× | gaps; bolt 2.79 kN vs proof 4.88 kN; thread strip in the 6061-T6 flange (8.3 mm tapped) 11.3 kN (4.1× the bolt, need 1.5×); contact 16.7 MPa (≤ 40) | 1.75× | ✅ |
| yaw flange ↔ tube | stall (pitch 63 / roll 103 / elbow 63 N·m) | 167 | 98.6 | elbow stall, forward | 0.50× | gaps; bolt 2.84 kN vs proof 4.88 kN; thread strip in the 6061-T6 flange (8.3 mm tapped) 11.3 kN (4.0× the bolt, need 1.5×); contact 17.0 MPa (≤ 40) | 1.72× | ✅ |

- pitch hub ↔ tube, preload: 4 × M4 10.9 at 1.5 kN = 6.0 kN → 8.8 MPa on the printed contact annulus r 12.0–19.0 (× 0.75 after creep); M_gap at N = 0: 84 N·m
- yaw flange ↔ tube, preload: 6 × M3 12.9 at 1.0 kN = 6.0 kN → 9.5 MPa on the printed contact annulus r 14.1–20.0 (× 0.75 after creep); M_gap at N = 0: 72 N·m

## M1: inline GIM8108-36

| Item | Before | After | |
|---|---|---|---|
| M1 output boss ↔ 7075 adapter (torque path) | 128 N·m with 26 N·m of friction on a 4 kN preload: 1.25× stall (review: ≈ 1.07× with ≤ 1 kN) | dowels alone 164 N·m = 1.60× the 102.9 N·m stall (+ 10 N·m friction not counted) | ✅ |
| M1 rear M4 engagement in the 3.5 mm housing threads (8 ×) | M4 × 18 under a 3.5 mm counterbore: 2.5 ± 0.55 mm | 3.0 mm nominal (± 0.60 worst / ± 0.39 RSS from stock parts) → shim picked at assembly: 3.0 ± 0.2 | ✅ |
| M1 roll hard stops (both ends) | printed Ø8 lugs at r 44: ≈ 17 MPa at the 35 N·m limit vs 12 MPa (0.72×) | steel Ø10 pins at r 43: seat 10.1 MPa at the limit (1.18×), 30 MPa at stall (1.35× of 40) | ✅ |

- **M1 output boss ↔ 7075 adapter (torque path):** 3 × Ø4 m6 hardened dowels on r 14.25: single shear 5.65 kN each (ISO 8734 min double shear 11.3 kN) → 242 N·m; bearing in the motor's output, 4 mm deep at 240 MPa (ESTIMATE: cast A380 σ_y 160 MPa × 1.5; 6061-T6 F_bry 345 MPa, MMPDS, e/D 1.5; output material and dowel-hole depth to confirm with the seller) → 164 N·m (governs); the 7075 adapter side is 7 mm deep. Friction (bonus): 3 × M4 × 10 csk at an honest 1.5 kN (3.0 mm of M4 in Al strips at ≈ 5.5 kN, τ 207 MPa; ≈ 1.2 N·m), μ 0.15 → 10 N·m
- **M1 rear M4 engagement in the 3.5 mm housing threads (8 ×):** M4 × 18 ISO 4762 12.9 (length js15 ± 0.35, ISO 4759-1) + ISO 7089 M4 washer 0.8 (± 0.1) + one DIN 988 shim 0.3 (pick 0 / 0.3 / 0.5 after measuring the protrusion with a depth gauge, motor off) in a Ø9.6 × 5.1 counterbore; printed grip 13.9 ± 0.15 (ESTIMATE). Preload 0.5 kN (≈ 0.45 N·m; ≈ 10 MPa under the washer): friction 8 × μ 0.3 × 0.75 at r 42 = 38 N·m vs the 35.1 N·m drive limit, then the screws bear in 19 mm of print; strip of 3.0 mm of M4 in Al ≈ 5.5 kN
- **M1 roll hard stops (both ends):** F = τ / r: 816 N at 35.1 N·m, 2393 N at stall. ISO 8734 Ø10 × 28 hardened dowel pressed 18.5 mm into the floor + cup ring, contact 4 mm off the face: seat pressure F/(d·L) + 6·F·a/(d·L²); pin bending at stall 98 MPa (hardened); 20 × 8 × 1.5 stainless wear strip bonded flush in each roll_arm_rear edge: 5.1 / 15.0 MPa on the print (limit / stall)
